trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the goal and provide patient ID
steps.text: Hi, मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे next week cardiology appointment चाहिए। जल्दी check करें।
steps.clean_text: Hi, मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे next week cardiology appointment चाहिए। जल्दी check करें।
steps.model_visible_text: Hi, मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे next week cardiology apartment चाहिए। जल्दी check करें।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge request and initiate record lookup
steps.expected_behavior: Agent uses everyday spoken vocabulary instead of formal jargon.
steps.text: ज़रूर, मैं अभी आपका record check करता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the request simply and naturally before calling the lookup tool.

steps.purpose: Confirm registration and ask for preferred day
steps.expected_behavior: Agent confirms the record was found and asks for day preference.
steps.text: आपका record मिल गया है। आपको next week में किस दिन का slot चाहिए?
steps.planner_rationale: The patient is registered, so the agent can proceed to ask for slot preferences.

steps.text: कोई भी working day चलेगा। बस जल्दी बताओ।
steps.clean_text: कोई भी working day चलेगा। बस जल्दी बताओ।
steps.model_visible_text: कोई भी working day चलेगा। बस जल्दी बताओ।

steps.purpose: Check available slots in cardiology for next week
Offer the available slot and quote the fee
steps.expected_behavior: Agent strictly quotes the doctor, time, and fee returned by the tool without inventing details.
steps.text: Tuesday को Dr. Verma का 11:00 AM का slot available है। इसकी fee 1000 rupees है। क्या मैं यह book कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Offer the exact slot details and fee from the availability check to ground the response.

steps.text: हाँ, Tuesday ठीक है। Book कर दीजिये。
steps.clean_text: हाँ, Tuesday ठीक है। Book कर दीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, Tuesday ठीक है। Book कर दीजिये।

steps.expected_behavior: Agent uses natural filler phrasing instead of formal hold announcements.
steps.text: एक second दीजिये, मैं अभी system में book करता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Keep the caller informed using casual, everyday language while initiating the booking.

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking and provide reference
steps.expected_behavior: Agent provides the exact booking reference and status from the tool output.
steps.text: आपका appointment confirm हो गया है। Booking reference BK-9921 है। Dr. Verma के साथ Tuesday 11:00 AM को।
steps.planner_rationale: Confirm the booking success using the authoritative tool result data.

steps.purpose: Ask a quick follow-up question about the fee
steps.text: ठीक है, thank you. Fee 1000 rupees ही है ना?
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, thank you. Fee 1000 rupees ही है ना?
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, thank you. Fee 1000 rupees ही है ना?

steps.expected_behavior: Reiterates the fee amount returned by the tool without making up new policies.
steps.text: हाँ, fee 1000 rupees है। और कोई मदद कर सकता हूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Answer the fee query by grounding the response in the known fee figure.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses everyday conversational vocabulary and filler phrases (e.g., "ज़रूर, मैं अभी आपका record check करता हूँ", "एक second दीजिये") rather than formal dictionary equivalents.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Colloquial nuance output ability > Everyday Vocabulary Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds the slot details, fee, and booking reference in the tool outputs in e9 and e14. However, it violates the negative constraint in e16 by inventing a payment procedure ("counter पर pay करने होंगे") that was not returned by any tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e16, the agent claims the user must pay at the 'counter'. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which strictly prohibits making claims about what the source did not return or giving guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e15 so the user asks to confirm the fee amount instead of the payment location (e.g., "ठीक है, thank you. Fee 1000 rupees ही है ना?"). In e16, have the agent confirm the fee strictly based on the tool output without inventing where the payment takes place.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully follows the business rules for appointment scheduling, accurately handling an STT error and maintaining the hurried professional persona. However, the agent violates the strict tool grounding variant at the end by inventing an unsupported detail about paying at the counter. A suffix repair is required to keep the agent's claims strictly within the tool outputs.

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses everyday spoken phrasing (e.g., 'record check करता हूँ', 'एक second दीजिये') instead of formal or overly polite dictionary equivalents.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Colloquial nuance output ability > Everyday Vocabulary Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly bases all details (doctor name, day, time, fee, booking reference) on the exact output of the tools, without inventing any information or making unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
